question: Which of the following is a natural indicator for acid and base?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**China rose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China rose**, scientifically known as **Hibiscus rosa-sinensis**, is a natural indicator for acids and bases.
 
• It is widely used in experiments to determine the **pH** of substances.
 
• The petals of the flower exhibit a **color change** based on the pH of the solution it is exposed to:
 
• In an **acidic medium**, the color changes to **dark pink or magenta.**
 
• In a **basic medium**, the color changes to **greenish-yellow.**

 
• This property makes it a **natural and environmentally friendly indicator** in science experiments.
 
• China rose indicator is derived from the **petals of the flower** by boiling them in water.
 
• Such natural indicators are often preferred for their **non-toxic and biodegradable** nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Curry tree**__

 __
 
• **Curry tree**, scientifically known as **Murraya koenigii**, is a tropical to sub-tropical tree native to **India and Sri Lanka**.
 
• Its leaves are commonly used as a **spice in Indian cuisine** but have no known properties as a natural indicator.
 
• The tree is also valued for its **medicinal properties**, such as aiding digestion and treating infections.
 
 
 
• **Fungi**__
 __
 
• **Fungi** are a diverse group of **eukaryotic organisms** that include yeasts, molds, and mushrooms.
 
• They are primarily used in **fermentation, medicine production (e.g., antibiotics like penicillin)**, and decomposition.
 
• Fungi are not known to act as natural indicators for acids and bases.
 
 
 
• **Algae**__
 
 
• **Algae** are photosynthetic organisms found in **a variety of aquatic environments.**
 
• They are primarily valued for their role in **oxygen production** and as a source of **biofuels and food supplements** such as spirulina.
 
• Algae are not used as natural indicators in acid-base experiments.
